 Stephon Castle flirts with double-double Friday against Kings 
 by Chris Schommer | Spurs Correspondent | Sat, Nov 7th 2026, 10:37am EST 
 Stephon Castle flirted with a double-double for the Spurs Friday night, dishing out seven assists and chipping in 19 points (7-13 FG, 1-3 3PT, 4-5 FT) while also grabbing three rebounds in a 124-109 win over the Kings. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Castle continues a steady stretch on both ends of the floor, finishing with three or more assists, three or more rebounds, and 14 or more points in four of his last five games. The 22-year-old remains one of many impactful options in a deep San Antonio lineup, averaging 15.4 points, 5.0 assists, and 5.8 rebounds per game while posting a usage rate of 24.2% so far this season.
